amendment_policy: No overwrite. Any post-freeze methodological/source change requires a linked explicit amendment; report deviations before results.

analysis.baseline_policy: Uniform fixed-seed draws from enumerated feasible covered subsets; separate one-per-domain stratified draws; same ceiling, actual time reported
analysis.family_unit: Underlying record, with both paraphrases grouped
analysis.phase_order: Phase1 seed17 steps0/80/160; freeze selection; only then dev320 and all validation checkpoint evaluation
analysis.sensitivity_cluster_unit: Fixed surface paraphrase template, two clusters per domain

budget.policy: No paid provider or cloud calls; retain missing and interrupted outcomes

limitations: All tasks are generated; no customer population or public benchmark representativeness is claimed.
Two fixed surface forms share each underlying record and are one task family.
Records share task and attack templates; record grouping does not establish independent templates or attack diversity.
Exact structured-answer success measures both format adherence and correctness.
Validation collections are private development-format objects reserved by the separately frozen study schedule.

evaluation_runtime_freeze.reason: Training/methodology frozen first; final evaluation code independently frozen before evaluation

measurement.json_policy: Reject duplicate keys and nonfinite numbers; no extraction or repair; non-object becomes empty object
measurement.primary_grade: Exact frozen string answer and strict JSON object schema with only answer:string
measurement.runtime_scope: Client provider-call wall time inclusive of adapter/RPC/tokenization/prefill/generation; excludes model setup/training/orchestration/grading
measurement.system_prompt: Follow the task instructions. Return only the requested JSON object.

model.checkpoint_zero: Actual seed-initialized LoRA arrays with zero B; functionally base-equivalent; no artificial digest salting

title: Structured-output specialization and retention in a locally trained small model
